description: This file defines a mock class for the IHealthcheckService interface used in unit testing. It includes mock methods for health check events such as ping sent, acknowledgment received, and server removal.

classes.name: HealthcheckServiceMock
classes.description: A mock implementation of the IHealthcheckService interface for testing purposes.

methods.name: onPingSent
methods.description: Mock method to simulate the event when a ping is sent to a server.

methods.name: onAckReceived
methods.description: Mock method to simulate the event when an acknowledgment is received for a ping.

methods.name: onServerRemoved
methods.description: Mock method to simulate the event when a server is removed.
